title: [Hinglish - Instagram/YouTube only] Gemini 4 Carbon - abhi aapke paas nahi
content:
Google ne October 28 ko
Gemini 4 Carbon announce kiya.
Google ke blog ke hisaab se
ye unka strongest model hai,
cybersecurity aur long-horizon kaam ke liye.
Lekin aaj aap ise use nahi kar sakte.
That is the part most headlines skip.

Google keh raha hai,
is hafte Carbon sirf
ek subset of cyber defenders ko milega.
Trusted partners ko baad mein,
Fairwind Program ke through.
Developers, businesses, aur consumers
ke liye abhi available nahi hai.
Google ye bhi keh raha hai
ki wo U.S. government ke
voluntary pre-release testing process mein hai.
So if someone sells you Carbon access today,
that is not what Google wrote.

Ab numbers, Google ke apne blog se.
Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5 pe
Carbon number 1 hai, score 59.
Vulnerabilities dhoondhne wale
SEC-bench Pro pe 88.2%.
ExploitGym pe 54.8%.
Patches ke liye
Collinear ke CWE-bench pe 71.0%.
Ye Google-reported scores hain,
independent re-test nahi.
On internal tests, Google says
unsupported claims Argon se
about 2 times kam hain.
Internal number hai. Treat it that way.

Price bhi likhi hai,
jab ye developers tak aayega.
Introductory price
$2 per 1,000,000 input tokens,
$10 per 1,000,000 output tokens.
Introductory period ke baad
$4 aur $20.
Cached input, Google ke hisaab se,
input price se 95% off.

To aap aaj kya kar sakte ho?
Carbon ka login mat dhoondo.
Apne code pe wahi 3 kaam practice karo
jo Google is model se karwana chahta hai.
1. Bug dhoondo.
2. Pocho, kya ye bug sach mein exploitable hai.
3. Root cause ka patch likho,
aur patch ko khud chala kar dekho.
A smaller model on your laptop
can do the drill.
The score on Google's chart
is not your score.

Mera take simple hai.
Naya frontier model
tab useful hai jab aapke paas access ho,
aur jab aap uske output ko check kar sako.
Abhi access nahi hai.
Skill abhi ban sakti hai.
Jab Fairwind ya public launch aaye,
tab price aur access dobara padh lena.
Aaj ka blog kal ka access nahi hai.

Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
